## Problem description

Clear and concise description of what isn't working.

## Where the problem is located

- [ ] Manifesto
- [ ] Framework (principles, gates, metrics)
- [ ] Operating Model (roles, modes)
- [ ] Artifacts (schema, templates, examples)
- [ ] AI Service Mesh
- [ ] Playbook
- [ ] Workflow / Diagrams
- [ ] Adoption (30/60/90, antipatterns)
- [ ] JSON Schemas
- [ ] Documentation (README, CONTRIBUTING, etc.)
- [ ] Other: ___

## Expected behavior

What you expected to find or read.

## Actual behavior

What you found instead.

## Impact

- [ ] Blocks framework adoption
- [ ] Causes confusion on a key concept
- [ ] Inconsistency between documents
- [ ] Typographical or formatting error
- [ ] Improvement suggestion

## Additional context

ORDITO version, link to file/section, screenshots if useful.
